{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the response variable is 'responded'
response_col = 'responded'

# Check for any potential confounding variables between sites
# Cross-tabulate site vs arm, site vs severity, site vs sex
confounding_check = pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['arm'])
confounding_check_severity = pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['severity'])
confounding_check_sex = pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['sex'])

# Print the cross-tabulations
print("Arm distribution by site:\n", confounding_check)
print("\nSeverity distribution by site:\n", confounding_check_severity)
print("\nSex distribution by site:\n", confounding_check_sex)"}
